description: This file contains the implementation of the Reward class within the Opencart system, specifically for the API's sale reward functionality. It defines API endpoints for handling reward points, including obtaining maximum reward points, checking available reward points, and applying rewards.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Controller class for handling reward points API for sale modules in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the reward point redemption process, validating reward points, and updating session data.

methods.name: maximum
methods.description: Calculates and returns the maximum reward points available based on the cart contents.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Provides the current reward points available to the customer.
